title: Covariance bound by query influences
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability distribution $\pi$, and let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose the space of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ has a basis that is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product and contains the constant-one function. For any nonnegative integer $n$, let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ coordinates with real outputs that computes $f$, and let $f$ and $g$ take values only in $\{-1,1\}$. Then their covariance under the product distribution with marginal $\pi$ satisfies $\operatorname{Cov}(f,g)\leq\sum_i q_i I_i(g)$, where $q_i$ is the probability that $T$ queries coordinate $i$ and $I_i(g)$ is the squared norm of the coordinate Laplacian of $g$ in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: π is a probability distribution on Ω
A basis of functions on Ω is orthonormal for π and contains the constant-one function
A real-output decision tree on n coordinates
A function f computed by the tree
